name: Panther Mastery
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
If you want to be a part of the hunt with this crack group under Hemet's leadership, you're going to need to prove yourself an able panther hunter.  We'll start you out easy -- don't you worry.  Let's see you kill 10 young panthers to start.

Tracking them down is only half the challenge...
narrative.objectives: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Young Panthers.
narrative.offerRewardText: Off to a good start, adventurer!
narrative.requestItemsText: A true panther hunter would be out in the fields, trying to stalk his prey. Show some commitment to your goal, champion, and get back out there.
